name: Link External Audio
description: Step 1 makes a safe copy of the active sequence ("<name> TOOLKIT COPY") and opens it. Step 2 syncs: put the external wav files anywhere on an audio track of the copy (e.g. after the clips) and it lines a wav piece up under each camera clip by matching waveforms; clips it is not sure about are listed for you to sync by hand. Step 3 links each camera clip to its camera audio and the wav piece under it. Every link is checked afterwards.

actions.label: 2  Sync external audio
actions.confirm: Sync the external wavs to the camera clips on this TOOLKIT COPY? It measures each clip against the wavs by waveform (can take a minute or two) and places a wav piece under each clip it is sure about, on the track the wavs are on. Nothing is deleted or moved.
